name: SHARMA, Devanand (Dave) Noel

headline.note: Official sources establish a continuous sequence of Commonwealth diplomatic and national-security roles from a 1999 DFAT graduate intake through the end of the Israel ambassadorship in 2017, followed by commercial advisory work. Exact appointment boundaries, substantive hours, leave, secondments and overlaps are incomplete. Study, ministerial political staff, company governance, candidacy and elected office are excluded, and no full-time totals are inferred from senior titles or year-only ranges.

career_spells.role: Student in natural sciences and law; BA, LLB (Honours) and MA
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament records Cambridge qualifications, Sharma says he changed from science to law, and professional biographies identify first-class honours. The cited sources do not establish exact enrolment or award dates beyond the reported 1994–1997 undergraduate interval.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: University of Sydney and Deakin University
career_spells.role: Medical student for one year; Master of Arts (International Relations) student
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament lists the Deakin qualification, while Sharma and professional biographies describe a year of Sydney medical study before joining DFAT and later completing international-relations study. Exact dates, loads and overlap with DFAT work are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
career_spells.evidence_note: Sharma states that he joined DFAT as a graduate in 1999. The exact commencement date, graduate placement, classification, hours, leave and transition to Bougainville are not published in the cited sources.
career_spells.counting_note: Commonwealth employment is supported, but year-only boundaries and missing full-time evidence prevent an exact duration calculation.

career_spells.employer: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade / Peace Monitoring Group
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament records the senior civilian adviser role in 2000, and Sharma later called Bougainville his first overseas posting. Exact deployment and payroll dates, hours, leave and overlap with the DFAT graduate appointment are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: The public posting is supported, but a single year label does not provide a countable interval or prove substantive full-time status throughout.

career_spells.employer: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
career_spells.role: Third Secretary, Australian High Commission in Port Moresby
career_spells.evidence_note: Official and first-person sources identify the Port Moresby posting from 2001 to 2003. Exact appointment and transfer dates, classification, hours, leave and the 2003–2004 transition are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Public diplomatic service is supported, but year-only boundaries and missing hours prevent an exact full-time calculation.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Minister for Foreign Affairs, the Hon Alexander Downer MP
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament and a professional paper biography record ministerial advisory work from 2004 to 2006. Exact appointment dates, payroll arrangement, hours, leave and whether DFAT employment was held on secondment or leave are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Ministerial political staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
career_spells.role: Political Counsellor, Australian Embassy in Washington
career_spells.evidence_note: Official and professional sources record the Washington posting from 2006 to 2009. Exact transfer dates, classification, hours, leave and the 2009–2010 interval are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Public diplomatic service is supported, but the year-only range and missing full-time evidence prevent exact counting.

career_spells.employer: Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet
career_spells.role: Assistant Secretary and acting First Assistant Secretary, International Division
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament records the International Division role from 2010 to 2012. A contemporaneous PM&C profile says Sharma transferred from DFAT in January 2010 and had acted as First Assistant Secretary by May 2011. Exact appointment and cessation dates, classification changes, hours, leave and the legal secondment arrangement are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Commonwealth public service is supported, but mixed date precision, acting arrangements and missing substantive-hours evidence prevent an exact total.

career_spells.employer: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament and the ambassador appointment record identify the Africa Branch role from 2012 to 2013. Exact transfer, appointment and cessation dates, hours, leave and overlap with PM&C or ambassador preparation are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Public service is supported, but year-only boundaries and missing hours prevent exact counting.

career_spells.employer: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament records service from 2013 to 2017, and contemporaneous records identify appointment in June 2013 and announcement of a successor in April 2017 for a mid-year transition. Exact assumption and cessation days, hours, leave and post-return arrangements remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: The public appointment is clear, but senior title and mixed date precision do not independently establish a countable full-time interval.

career_spells.role: Director and Principal, Government Relations, Incentives and Innovation
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament records a Kelly+Partners directorship from 2018 to 2019, and an April 2019 ASPI paper identifies Sharma as Director and Principal of its Government Relations, Incentives and Innovation practice. Public-profile reporting gives a January 2018 start. Exact appointment and cessation days, employee or contractor status, hours, leave, remuneration and campaign overlap are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private advisory work is supported, but title, mixed date precision and missing substantive-hours evidence are insufficient for a full-time calculation.

career_spells.employer: Shekel Brainweigh Ltd and other technology ventures
career_spells.evidence_note: ASX and employer sources identify Sharma as founding chair of Shekel Brainweigh and describe other advisory-board and consulting work in defence, agriculture, medical technology and autonomous vehicles. Individual appointment dates, entities, remuneration, workload and overlaps are incomplete; the 2020 end is an upper boundary from Shekel reporting, not a complete end date for every engagement.
career_spells.counting_note: Non-executive governance and advisory engagements are visible but excluded from full-time totals absent evidence of substantive paid employment.

career_spells.role: Candidate for Wentworth in the 2018 by-election and 2019 federal election
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament records both candidacies, and party material confirms election to Wentworth in 2019. Exact preselection dates, remuneration, workload and overlap with Kelly+Partners and company boards are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party candidacy and campaigning are excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Member of the House of Representatives for Wentworth
career_spells.evidence_note: Official and professional sources establish House service from the 18 May 2019 election until the 21 May 2022 election.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament records director and partner work from 2022 to 2023. SWG announced Sharma as Partner on 6 June 2023 and later said he left commercial operations for the Senate. The 2022 director start, exact cessation day, partner/director duties, hours, remuneration, leave and other venture-capital overlaps are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private commercial work is supported, but mixed boundaries, changing titles and missing substantive-hours evidence prevent an exact total.

career_spells.evidence_note: The NSW Parliament chose Sharma on 30 November 2023 to fill the casual Senate vacancy, and Parliament records service from that day.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded under the codebook.

research_notes: Obtain Commonwealth payroll and appointment records from the 1999 DFAT graduate intake through the 2017 ambassador cessation, including exact transfer dates, classifications, substantive hours, leave and secondment arrangements across Bougainville, Port Moresby, the Downer office, Washington, PM&C, Africa Branch and Israel.
Resolve the 2003–2004, 2009–January 2010 and post-ambassadorship transition periods, and date the Sydney medicine and Deakin international-relations study precisely against employment.

Obtain Kelly+Partners contract, cessation, hours, remuneration and campaign-overlap evidence; enumerate and date Shekel Brainweigh and other technology-company governance, consulting and advisory appointments without treating board titles as full-time work.

Obtain SWG Capital's 2022 director appointment, June 2023 partner terms, hours, remuneration and exact commercial cessation; resolve other venture-capital and nonprofit board overlaps and both Wentworth campaign periods.
